module: Bridge between the mission system and the UI (Vue): prepares the mission screen data (missions at the current marker, ongoing mission, list tiles, active stars according to settings, starting options, entry fee, repair, required vehicle class), starts or stops a mission from the UI, handles navigation to a mission on the big map and the end screen sounds. Almost all its functions are called by the interface via Lua commands (e.g. gameplay_missions_missionScreen.startMissionById); results are sent back via guihooks.trigger.
notes: User settings coming from the UI are a list {{key, value, ...}}; startMissionById, startFromWithinMission flatten them into a key -> value table before passing them to the missionManager.

startMissionById refuses (logged error) a mission that is not startable (gameplay_missions_unlocks.isMissionStartable) unless startingOptions.skipUnlockCheck is true; startingOptions.startedFrom is "missionScreen" by default. It returns nothing.
Starting repair costs are fixed: 1000 (money) or 1 voucher.
Bug: in formatMission, `m.missionTypeLabel or mission.missionType` uses the global `mission` (nil) instead of `m`; if missionTypeLabel is absent, an error is raised.
Bug: in openVehicleSelectorForMissionBySetting, `settingIdx = i` uses an undefined variable `i` (the loop uses `_`): settingIdx is always nil.
Bug: in getMissionScreenData, the hook onAvailableMissionsSentToUi is emitted with `context`, a variable undefined at this point (nil).

openAPMChallenges fills openMenuWithCustomMissionList with {mode='leagues'} then adds ids to it: the table mixes the "mode" key and sequential elements (only the sequential elements are read afterwards).
enableDebug(true) replaces M.onUpdate with debugOnUpdate ("Mission Start Screen History" imgui window with the last 20 layouts); M.onUpdate is nil otherwise.
The savedLayouts and testLayout fields are nil by default: savedLayouts is filled by discoverLayouts, testLayout is a test field never assigned in this file.

activateSoundBlur calls core_sounds.setAudioBlur(1 or 0); the previous 3D sound code is commented out. activateSound creates three AudioGui sources (money, xp, vouchers) and never destroys them (tryDeleteSoundObject is empty).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand: gameplay_missions_missions, gameplay_markerInteraction, gameplay_playmodeMarkers.

uiLayoutHistory.desc: The last 20 mission screen layouts received by onMissionScreenReady (with recordedAt and recordedAtFormatted).

savedLayouts.desc: Test layouts read from /gameplay/testing/*.json by discoverLayouts; nil before the first call.

testLayout.desc: Test layout returned by onRequestMissionScreenData when the mode contains "test"; nil by default.

getRepairCostForStartingRepairType.desc: Cost of the repair offered at the start of a career mission: "moneyRepair" -> {money=1000}, "voucherRepair" -> {vouchers=1}, otherwise nil.

resolvePlayerVehicleClass.desc: Performance class of the player's vehicle as {class={name, description, minPI}, performanceIndex}: active inventory vehicle in career, otherwise the current player vehicle via gameplay_vehiclePerformance.getClassFromVehId.

returns.desc: Class data, or nil if unavailable.

resolveDefaultMissionVehicleClass.desc: Class of the vehicle the mission would use by default (preselected option in its settings). The selection rules are in gameplay_vehiclePerformance.getDefaultMissionVehicleSpec; for an imposed vehicle (preset) the class comes from getClassFromConfig, otherwise it falls back to the player's.

resolveRequirementState.desc: Compares the current class and the required class by name: "met" if identical, "unmet" if different, "unknown" if one is missing.

resolveMissionVehicleClassRequirement.desc: Returns the vehicle class required by the mission (missionTypeData.vehicleGroupByClassActive and vehicleGroupByClass), built with gameplay_vehiclePerformance.buildClassRequirement; "auto" takes the player's class (B by default), "userSetting" gives nil (choice in the settings).

returns.desc: Class requirement, or nil if there is none.

formatMission.desc: Puts a mission in the format expected by the UI (id, translated name, icon, description, preview, type label, stars, settings, required class, career leagues, etc.).

getMissionsAtCurrentLocationFormatted.desc: List of the missions of the marker where the player is, already formatted and sorted by unlock depth; nil if the game state has no playmode markers.

getMissionScreenData.desc: Mission screen data: if a mission is in progress, returns the "ongoingMission" context (ongoing mission, recovery options, buttons hidden during the tutorial or looping rally); otherwise the "availableMissions" context (marker missions or custom list, tiles, preselected mission/page, ongoing delivery warning) or "empty".

returns.desc: Table with the context field and the associated data.

requestStartingOptionsForUserSettings.desc: Computes the starting options for the given settings and sends them to the UI via the guihook "missionStartingOptionsForUserSettingsReady" ({missionId, options, entryFee}). Checks: mission startable, personal vehicle chosen, starting on foot impossible, entry fee payable, vehicle class, and offers the paid repair in career if the vehicle is damaged.

getActiveStarsForUserSettings.desc: Determines which stars are active, visible and enabled for given settings (after recomputing dynamic rewards, ignoring the keys of ignoreUserSettingsKeyForActiveStars). Stores the settings in m._lastUserSettingsOutsideOfMission.

userSettings.desc: List {key, value} or flat key -> value table.

returns.desc: Table containing notably starInfo per star key; empty table if the mission does not exist.

getPauseMissionObjectivesData.desc: Pause menu data (Vue component MissionObjectives): merges the unlocked stars with the active star rules for the settings of the current mission.

returns.desc: {stars, message, showMessage}; stars is empty if there is no mission or no stars.

startMissionById.desc: Starts a mission with a fade (gameplay_missions_missionManager.startWithFade) after flattening the settings. Logs an error if the id is invalid or if the mission is not startable.

stopMissionById.desc: Requests the abandonment (with fade) of the mission with the given id, or of the foreground mission if id is nil.

abandonButtonPressed.desc: true if the player is the one abandoning.

abandonCurrentMission.desc: Abandons the current mission as if the player had pressed the abandon button.

startFromWithinMission.desc: Restarts/reconfigures a mission from within a running mission (flattens the settings then calls missionManager.startFromWithinMission).

id.desc: Id of the mission to start.

changeUserSettings.desc: Called when the player changes a setting: determines the corresponding progress key (mission:getProgressKeyForUserSetting) and sends to the UI, via the guihook "missionProgressKeyChanged", {progressKey, translation, progress} with the reformatted aggregates. Uses the parent mission if missionIdForAttempt is set. Despite its name, it does not modify any setting.

setPreselectedPage.desc: Sets the mission screen page to open (used only once by getMissionScreenData).

setPreselectedMissionId.desc: Sets the mission preselected when the mission screen opens.

activateSoundBlur.desc: Enables or disables the audio blur (core_sounds.setAudioBlur) during the mission screen.

activateSound.desc: Plays (with the given pitch) or stops the counting sounds of the end screen (money, xp, vouchers).

active.desc: true to play; false stops all counting sounds.

openAPMChallenges.desc: Opens the career challenges screen (starting "league" missions of the current level, filtered by branch and skill) via ui_router.navigate ("mission.details" by default).

navigateToMission.desc: Opens the big map centered on a mission (freeroam_bigMapMode.enterBigMap, instant); POI selection and navigation are then done by onBigMapActivated.

onBigMapActivated.desc: Hook called when the big map opens: if a navigation to a mission is pending (and older than 3 s), selects the POI and starts the navigation.

openVehicleSelectorForMissionBySetting.desc: Opens the vehicle selector for a mission's "custom vehicle" setting, then returns to the mission's "settings" page with the chosen model and config.

settingKey.desc: Key of the vehicle selection setting.

getMissionTiles.desc: Builds the tiles of the current level's mission list (filters, groups by difficulty and "all", sorting). Without ids, keeps only the missions visible in freeroam; with ids, only those.

returns.desc: Table including tilesById, and the sorted groups (details in the code).

discoverLayouts.desc: Debug tool: reads the JSON layouts of /gameplay/testing into M.savedLayouts.

enableDebug.desc: Debug tool: enables/disables the imgui window of the layout history (affects M.onUpdate).

debugOnUpdate.desc: Imgui debug window, used as onUpdate when enableDebug(true).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook on extension unload; does nothing (commented-out code).

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook at level end; does nothing (commented-out code).

onMissionScreenReady.desc: Hook sent when the mission screen is displayed: stores the received UI layout (last 20).

uiLayout.desc: Layout sent by the UI (receives recordedAt).

onRequestMissionScreenData.desc: Test ("Todo: Remove"): if the mode contains "test", returns to the UI a copy of M.testLayout via the guihook "onRequestMissionScreenDataReady".

isAnyMissionActive.desc: Returns whether a foreground mission is in progress.

returns.desc: true if a mission is active.

isMissionStartOrEndScreenActive.desc: Broadcasts the hook onGetIsMissionStartOrEndScreenActive; a module that displays the mission start/end screen answers it by adding a value.

returns.desc: First value added by a listener, or false.
